# Lazarus Juice with two Conduit sources

Natural seed68586509/LazarusLeague/LunaCoven Ring6, Pyre26 save chain.
A bounded deployment grid puts both Silent Sentinels on the top floor.
The AuroraWeaver summon at turn2 refreshes the hand with two distinct
Conduit modifiers: conduit:4 and conduit:3, each+5 damage/+5 healing.
Lazarus's Juice card13 previously accepted at most one such modifier,
so the whole summon branch was rejected. Native observation094416-fc61e5b7
preserves the original rejection and all20 actual inputs/state/RNG.

Release211 admits at most two distinct, individually validated pure Conduit
modifiers. Duplicate owners, a third source, unknown identity and altered
cost/health/healing payloads remain rejected. The20-input full successor
and four immutable parallel branches pass. The old27-input single-source
cast pair and its eleven guards remain unchanged. The dual-source cast's
payment, Juice scaling and Consume still require independent native replay;
this branch calibration is not a campaign victory or a default-budget win.
